name: Discrete Diode — 31V — D
description: Cluster of 5 tier A discrete 31V diodes in D package family featuring surface-mount and through-hole footprints including DO-15 and SOD-323.
selection_hints: Select based on required mounting style: surface-mount (SOD-323) or through-hole (DO-15).
Choose between TVS diode footprints (BZW04, BZW06) or Zener diode footprints.
Select part source from Alternate-KiCad-Library or JLCPCB-Kicad-Library.
avoid_when: Do not use when a package family other than D is required.
Avoid if the application requires a voltage rating other than 31V.
Avoid if footprint requirements differ from DO-15 horizontal pitch 10.16mm or SOD-323.
